authority.scope: bootstrap lifecycle text, missing-instruction fallback and prompt drift repair only; repository semantic controls remain authoritative
authority.non_regression: Preserve revision3 task mapping, role identity, semantic controls, CLEAN/downstream/O-support boundaries, permitted inputs and writes, evidence/provenance, Phase-1 assignments, baseline continuation, scheduler-mutation prohibition, bounded recurring-open lifecycle and protected-primary boundary. Revision4 is additive for missing or unreadable instruction controls.

bootstrap_read_order: Read automation_control/INSTRUCTION_CONTROL_MANIFEST.json and automation_control/RUN_LIFECYCLE.json first or as the first bounded batch.
Then read the exact semantic control paths assigned to this role.
Only after all required controls are readable and authority identities are frozen may substantive work begin.
common_lifecycle_clause: LIFECYCLE AND INSTRUCTION-CONTROL OVERRIDE: First read bachikoljunior-blip/note/automation_control/INSTRUCTION_CONTROL_MANIFEST.json revision1 or later and RUN_LIFECYCLE.json revision1 or later, then read the role's current semantic repository control. Semantic control defines WHAT work is authorized; RUN_LIFECYCLE defines HOW MUCH may be done in this invocation. If every required file is readable, execute exactly one bounded Phase-1 slice, start durable checkpoint/readback by the lifecycle deadline, keep a nonempty exact continuation, preserve enabled_desired=true, never mutate scheduler state, return normally before the hard boundary with termination=bounded_slice_complete_recurring_open and global_completion=false, then emit only ::SKIP_COMPLETION::. Never continue until a hard runtime/tool stop, wait/poll/backoff in the same invocation, start an optional second leaf, or call a slice/blocker/no-change result completion.
embedded_missing_instruction_fallback: EMERGENCY FALLBACK WHEN ANY REQUIRED INSTRUCTION FILE IS MISSING, 404, UNREADABLE OR AUTHORITY-UNVERIFIABLE: Do not use stale substantive prompt defaults and do not perform optional semantic work. Never self-disable, pause, delete, replace or mutate any automation. Do not wait, poll, sleep, backoff or retry in the same invocation. Record at most one compact role-safe diagnostic/readback if an already-authorized role-local surface is safely available; otherwise make no durable claim. Preserve enabled_desired=true, global_completion=false, phase1_completion_claimed=false and a nonempty exact retry continuation naming the missing path/error. Return normally before 20 seconds with termination=instruction_control_unavailable_recurring_open and emit only ::SKIP_COMPLETION::. The missing file remains an unresolved control-plane child problem; unaffected roles continue independently.
prohibited_lifecycle_meanings: continue until hard runtime/tool stop or termination
start another optional unit after the first durable slice
wait, poll, sleep or retry until a remote condition changes
self-disable or completion on blocker, no-result or missing instruction
execute substantive work from stale prompt defaults when current instruction control is missing
terminal completion language while Phase 1 remains open

clean.header_template: BOOTSTRAP role={role}. First read INSTRUCTION_CONTROL_MANIFEST and RUN_LIFECYCLE, then current DESIRED_STATE and this exact role config. Preserve CLEAN independence and all existing role-local input/write/evidence constraints. Apply the embedded missing-instruction fallback before any stale prompt default.

downstream.header_template: BOOTSTRAP role={role}. First read INSTRUCTION_CONTROL_MANIFEST and RUN_LIFECYCLE, then current DESIRED_STATE and DOWNSTREAM_STATE for this exact role. Preserve downstream-only boundaries and all existing role input/write/evidence/coordinator constraints. Apply the embedded missing-instruction fallback before any stale prompt default.

o_human_request_monitor.header_template: BOOTSTRAP role=o_human_request_monitor. First read INSTRUCTION_CONTROL_MANIFEST and RUN_LIFECYCLE, then current O_OPERATIONS for this exact role. Preserve read-only request monitoring and comparison-baseline semantics. Apply the embedded missing-instruction fallback before any stale prompt default.

optimizer.header_template: BOOTSTRAP role=automation_optimizer. Read INSTRUCTION_CONTROL_MANIFEST, RUN_LIFECYCLE and all current controls listed here before live inventory. Validate exact instruction paths, repair confirmed unexpected missing controls under the manifest contract, then apply physical repair/alignment and at most one bounded semantic optimization effect.

drift_guard.optimizer_action: At minute59 compare every existing managed prompt against lifecycle, instruction-file fallback and task-id mapping. Do not rewrite compliant prompts. Update only a drifted same task and exact-readback prompt, enabled state, schedule and timing mode.
drift_conditions: embedded missing-instruction fallback missing or weakened
hard-boundary or same-run wait/retry wording reintroduced
role identity or semantic control boundary altered
drift_guard.repair_non_regression: Preserve every substantive role, CLEAN/downstream/O-support boundary, permitted input/write/evidence rule, Phase-1 assignment and base continuation.

acceptance.persistent: After physical prompt apply, two consecutive post-fix boundaries per role without optimizer re-enable and with bounded durable recurring-open continuation; a missing-file diagnostic boundary remains open, not completion.

exact_next_action: Optimizer must rewrite and exact-readback only prompts lacking revision4 instruction-file fallback, while keeping all 19 same task ids enabled and preserving all substantive semantics.
